_README_COMMENTS: Keys starting with '_' are comments/documentation and are ignored by the generator.
_README_USAGE: Edit case_name, stl_files, and flow conditions. All other fields use robust built-in defaults.
_stl_files: ASCII STL geometry files located in the stl/ directory
_fidelity: Presets: 'fast' (~2-4M cells, 10 min, y+~100), 'standard' (~6-9M cells, 45 min, y+~40, RECOMMENDED for general aerodynamics), 'fine' (~12-16M cells, 2-4 hrs, y+~1). Each preset carries a near-wall y+ target that is converted to an absolute first-layer thickness from the flow velocity and fluid properties.

flow._velocity_comment: Freestream air velocity in m/s (16.67 m/s ≈ 60 km/h, 20.0 m/s = 72 km/h)
flow._direction_comment: Flow direction vector: +x, -x, +y, -y, +z, -z (direction the air travels)
flow._ground_comment: true = moving ground wall at freestream velocity; false = slip wall (free-air aero)

outputs._drag_axis_comment: Axis along which aerodynamic drag is reported (direction of freestream flow)
outputs._downforce_axis_comment: Axis along which downforce (-lift) is reported (-y = toward ground, +y = aircraft lift)

_domain_box_comment: 'auto' automatically fits wind tunnel around STL (4L upstream, 8L downstream, 4H top, 4W lateral). Or provide explicit {'min': [x, y, z], 'max': [x, y, z]}.
_symmetry_plane_comment: Centerline coordinate if model uses a symmetry plane (0.0 if centered at origin, or specify offset if origin is shifted). Omit if full 3D model.
_ground_position_comment: Optional ground elevation control (delete leading '_' from ONE key below to activate; omit both to snap to lowest STL vertex):
_ground_clearance_desc: Style 1 (Relative): Gap in meters below lowest STL point (e.g. 0.035 = 35mm ground clearance / ride height)
_ground_plane_desc: Style 2 (Absolute): Fixed CAD coordinate of ground / road elevation (e.g. 0.0 if geometry is positioned relative to origin)
_domain_faces_comment: Boundary types for the 6 outer box faces (-x, +x, -y, +y, -z, +z). Available types: inlet, outlet, ground, farField, symmetry.

parallel._comment: Number of CPU cores for MPI decomposition, snappyHexMesh meshing, and simpleFoam solving

slurm._comment: SLURM cluster configuration for HPC / compute cluster

_overrides_note: All fields below have built-in defaults in fidelity presets. Uncomment only if manual tuning is needed.

mesh_params._cells_per_length: Auto base cell = longest STL extent / this number (fast 20, standard 30, fine 37.5)
mesh_params._base_cell_size: Explicit metres; use 'auto' to derive from cells_per_length

layers._y_plus_target: Near-wall target. 1 = wall-resolved, 30-100 = wall functions. Overrides first_layer_thickness unless that is set explicitly.
layers._relativeSizes: false = first_layer_thickness/min_thickness are metres; true = fractions of the local cell size
layers._first_layer_thickness: Metres when relativeSizes is false, fraction of cell size when true
layers._min_thickness: Same units as first_layer_thickness. Must not exceed the total layer stack.
layers._ground_layers: Off by default. Opt-in prism layers on the moving ground patch; requires at least max(2 mm, 2x first layer) clearance and is capped by ground_n_layers.
layers._ground_n_layers: Maximum ground layer count (default 2, never more than n_layers)
